validity.recommendation: Keep as a real (but dormant) proposal; shelve as Presumed (see status review); fix endpoint direction (Iran -> Pakistan, not Pakistan -> Iran) and note capacity is top of a stated range.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE — confirmed as a real project, but only as a feasibility-study-stage MoU, never a built/advancing pipeline. This is the ~$10bn 'offshore gas pipeline' that Pakistan (Inter-State Gas Systems/ISGS) and Russia's Gazprom agreed to study: an inter-governmental feasibility-study MoU signed Sept 2018 in Moscow, reaffirmed Feb 2019. Corroborated by >=2 independent origins: The News/Pakistan ('Pakistan signs $10 bn gas pipeline agreement with Russia', Feb 7 2019), Warsaw Institute ('Russia Enters the Pakistan Gas Sector'), Express Tribune ('Pakistan, Russia set to sign $10b offshore pipeline deal'), Arab News/Dawn (MoU for feasibility study). NOT a hallucination and NOT GEM-only. CLASSIFICATION — correct: cross-border gas transmission trunk. DUPLICATE — checked against roster: this is NOT the same physical pipe as P0452 Iran-Pakistan Pipeline (that is the ONSHORE 'Peace Pipeline', Asaluyeh->Sindh, 2775 km, 56in, cap 750; this row is a distinct OFFSHORE deep-sea concept, Gazprom-financed, 1500 km, cap 500-1000 MMcf/d, $10bn); nor P7104 Russia-Iran Gas Pipeline (that supplies gas FROM Russia TO Iran, the 2024-25 Gazprom deal). No merge warranted. CAVEATS: (1) endpoint direction is recorded backwards — sources describe gas flowing FROM Iran (Gazprom's Middle East sources) TO Pakistan via Gwadar, but the sheet has StartCountryOrArea=Pakistan / EndCountryOrArea=Iran (worklist flags this Location unit irregular). (2) Capacity 1000 MMcf/d is the TOP of a stated '500 million to one billion cubic feet per day' range (The News) — defensible but not a firm single figure. (3) The whole project is dormant since 2019 (see status_reviews).

fills.researcher_notes: The News (Feb 7 2019) gives capacity as '500 million to one billion cubic feet of gas per day (MMCFD)'. GEM records 1000 MMcf/d, i.e. the TOP of that range. Ref added but flagged as range-derived (single strong source); leave the value as-is but note the upper-bound caveat rather than treating 1000 as firm.

Both The News and Warsaw Institute independently name Gazprom as the Russian developer/financier of the offshore pipeline (Pakistani counterparty is state-owned Inter-State Gas Systems, ISGS). Refs added for Owner=Gazprom. CAVEAT: the recorded '100%' Gazprom ownership is not directly stated — it was a bilateral feasibility MoU, not an equity structure; treat the 100% as inferential.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Hunted for evidence newer than the sheet's LastUpdated (2025-07-22). Found NONE that names this specific offshore Iran-Pakistan Gazprom pipeline. All independent traces cluster in 2017-2019: the Sept 2018 feasibility-study IGA and the Feb 7 2019 MoU (The News, Warsaw Institute, Express Tribune, Arab News, Dawn, Reuters). Post-2019 coverage of Russia-Pakistan gas cooperation is about the ONSHORE Pakistan Stream / North-South pipeline, and post-2024 Iran-Pakistan coverage is about the ONSHORE Peace Pipeline (P0452) — neither is this offshore deep-sea project. A Jan 2023 Pakistan Today energy-diplomacy op-ed discusses Pak-Russia energy ties generically but does not confirm the offshore project is alive. The offshore pipeline never advanced beyond a feasibility-study MoU and has been dormant ~7 years. Applying the dormancy rule (proposed with no progress >=2y -> shelved): recommend Status=shelved, ShelvedCancelledType=Presumed. No fabricated ref for the inference (standing rule 2); verifications above document the last real evidence (Feb 2019), not a shelve announcement. Given it is already well past 4 years dormant, a reviewer could reasonably go straight to cancelled/Presumed, but I default to the proposed->shelved step for a still-'proposed' row.

summary: P3174 Off-Shore Gas Pipeline (Iran<->Pakistan, Gazprom, $10bn/1500km/1000MMcfd) is a REAL but never-realized 2018-2019 feasibility-study MoU, dormant ~7yr -> stale, recommend shelved (Presumed); not a duplicate of P0452/P7104; endpoint direction recorded backwards and capacity is top-of-range; filled Capacity+Owner refs.
